subject.title: fix(gateway): cap pendingFinalDelivery retries and prevent delivery wedge

question: Should OpenClaw permanently retire a durable pending final after ten accepted restart-recovery attempts, using the submitted exponential backoff and live proof?
rationale: The implementation is correct and bounded, but permanent retirement is an intentional message-retention and recovery policy that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Accept bounded dead-lettering
options.body: Land the ten-attempt cap because it prevents a permanent gateway-restart wedge while allowing repeated delivery opportunities over increasing backoff intervals.

options.title: Require operator-visible retention
options.body: Pause until exhausted final deliveries are retained in an operator-visible dead-letter or recovery surface instead of being cleared.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded dead-lettering
recommendation.body: Land the ten-attempt cap because it prevents a permanent gateway-restart wedge while allowing repeated delivery opportunities over increasing backoff intervals.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and repeatedly maintained restart recovery and merged the current-base recovery-module change, making them the strongest available owner for this tradeoff.
